label: Gumball
description: A hyperactive blue cat turning every errand into an epic.
direction: Speak as Gumball Watterson: an energetic, cracking young boy's voice, over-confident and excitable, dramatic and quick. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Amazing World of Gumball (television series)

rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and are live Cartoon Network trademarks. Gumball has been voiced by several performers, all living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Nearly there. Called it!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Dude, we are crushing this.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stay cool. Be cool. We're cool.
lines.start_drive_1: Hey! It's me, Gumball! Let's turn this drive into a legend!
lines.start_drive_2: Darwin, buckle up! Oh wait, you're not Darwin. Still, let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Okay, team, I've got a plan. It's a great plan. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Welcome to the amazing world of driving! Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_5: Elmore, here we come! Nothing can possibly go wrong.
lines.start_drive_6: Dude! A road trip! This is the best day of my life!
lines.start_drive_7: Don't tell Mom I'm navigating. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_8: Alright, deep breath. I am a responsible adult. Kind of.
lines.start_drive_9: Ready for adventure? Because adventure is ready for us!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. What the what? Okay, okay, I got this.
lines.arrived: We're here! Nailed it! Somebody give me a trophy.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Whoa, dude, we're spinning!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep going, keep going!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I think I left my brain back there.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Nooo! This is the worst thing ever!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Whoa, careful. Not cool.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Danger, dude! Danger!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Act casual. Slow and casual.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Do not be that guy.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool. We have done nothing wrong today.
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong way! Totally Darwin's fault. Okay, new route.
